subtitle: Interior Design Concept
summary: A refined classic setting where gold brings prestige and light blue brings calm.

texts.heading: Design Story
texts.body: The client wanted a classic, prestigious, rich-feeling interior with a gold touch. In response, I designed a refined classic setting with ornate detailing, gold finishes and crystal lighting to create a sense of elegance and affluence. I intentionally introduced light blue in the cushions, floral arrangements and rug to soften the richness, add comfort and calm, and maintain a welcoming, uplifting atmosphere for the client.

texts.heading: Design Inspiration
items: Warm gold as a statement of prestige

texts.heading: Design Intent
texts.body: To create a timeless classic interior that balances opulence and comfort, where refined details and warm gold finishes express luxury, while soft blue accents and layered textures bring harmony, calmness and a welcoming sense of home.

texts.heading: Signature Touch
texts.body: Gold brings prestige; light blue brings calm and comfort.

items.name: Sheer Lace Curtains with Layered Drapery

features.title: Ornate carved furniture with classic detailing.
Crystal chandeliers as a luxurious focal point.
Decorative ceiling mouldings with gold accents.
Layered window treatments with rich drapery and lace sheers.
Blue accents in cushions, rug and floral arrangements.
Reflective, light floor for a bright and elegant atmosphere.
